items.title: Malaysia Airlines Orders Up To 16 Boeing 787-10s, Deliveries Start 2032
items.why: Malaysia Airlines placed its first Dreamliner order for up to 16 Boeing 787-10s, with deliveries starting in 2032.

items.title: GE Aerospace Announces Malaysia Aviation Group Selects GEnx Engines for Up to 16 Boeing 787 Dreamliners
items.why: GE Aerospace will supply GEnx engines to Malaysia Aviation Group for up to 16 Boeing 787 Dreamliners.
